subject: Request: Maven - Uptime SLO exception & remedy cap
messages:
From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@mavenanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@mavenanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jan 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLO discussion — proposed uptime

Thanks for the call today, Soojin. Maven's platform team reviewed the standard SLA and we have two asks: first, we need a written commitment to 99.9% uptime given our global traffic pattern and second, we need service credit language that caps remedies at 20% of monthly fees. We understand Redwood's standard is 99.95; we are requesting the slightly lower uptime target in exchange for a firm cap on credits.

Can you send a proposal PDF we can share with procurement and legal? We'll need redlines back within 4 business days to stay on the procurement timeline.

Olivia Hart
Head of IT Ops | Maven Analytics
[Attachment: request_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@mavenanalytics.com>
Cc: procurement@mavenanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: SLO discussion — proposed uptime

Olivia — appreciate the clarity. I've attached a draft SLA proposal that reflects the two items you listed: a committed uptime of 99.9% and a remedies section that limits cumulative service credits to 20% of monthly invoice for any single month.

Important context for your team: 99.95% is our default for Dedicated customers, but we can support 99.9% for this contract with two non-standard conditions: 1) an elevated onboarding readiness checklist (we'll require a joint runbook and DNS failover test within 30 days), and 2) an accepted fallthrough policy that permits temporary regional failovers without credit if our fallback procedures are executed and documented.

I'll need an executive approval from our deal desk for the non-standard uptime and for the remedies cap. Can you confirm the procurement contact for routing the final DocuSign? I'll escalate internally today.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLA_Proposal_v3.pdf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Maven SLA — exec approval request

Marissa — looping you in for an exec sign-off. Summary: Maven (revenue $1.1M ARR expected first year) requests a non-standard uptime SLO of 99.9% (standard 99.95) and an explicit cap on service credits at 20% of monthly fees. They agree to elevated onboarding requirements and a documented failover runbook.

Why I recommend approval: this deal is strategically valuable in the analytics vertical and our projected unit economics at 99.9% with the runbook requirement remains positive. We also preserve protections by requiring documented fallback actions and a one-month remedial cap.

Requested approvals (please reply with Approve / Reject / Need more info):
- Approve 99.9% uptime SLO for Maven (non-standard)
- Approve remedies cap at 20% of monthly invoice
- Approve special onboarding readiness milestone (DNS failover test in 30 days)

I've attached the final redline summary from legal and a clean SLA for signature. If approved, I'll route to Marissa for final signature and then DocuSign to the procurement contact.

Thanks,
Soojin
[Attachment: redline_summary.docx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jan 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Maven SLA — exec approval request

Soojin — reviewed. Approve with the following clarifications and operational commitments:
1) Approve 99.9% uptime SLO for this account only, term-limited to the initial 12-month contract.
2) Approve remedies cap at 20% but require a cumulative 10-day threshold for a single-month payout trigger (i.e., credits apply only if total outage days exceed 10 days equivalent of downtime across the billing month).
3) Require a written runbook and successful DNS failover test within 30 days; failure to complete grants Redwood the right to revert to 99.95 SLA in renewal negotiations.

Dylan/Laura — please coordinate the contract template updates and DocuSign workflow. Soojin, once you confirm procurement details I'll send the exec sign-off email to legal and ops for signature.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
